# Real Homes

> > Real Homes is a comprehensive home design and maintenance resource covering interior design trends, home improvement projects, cleaning solutions, and room-specific inspiration.

Real Homes provides expert-curated guides, product reviews, and design inspiration across cleaning, home improvement, interior design, and room-specific topics. The site features contributions from design experts and celebrity home inspiration to help readers transform their living spaces.

## Key Topics

- interior design
- home improvement
- DIY projects
- design trends
- home cleaning
- cleaning products
- product reviews
- bathroom design
- bedroom design
- home organization
- storage solutions
- home fragrance
- lighting design
- celebrity homes
- buying guides

## Interior Design & Inspiration

- [Interior Design Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/interior-design): Interior design trends, celebrity homes, and design inspiration
- [Rooms Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/rooms): Room-by-room design guides and celebrity home inspiration
- [Lighting Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/interior-design/lighting): Lighting design ideas and product reviews from designer picks
- [Floors Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/interior-design/floors): Flooring types, materials, and design trends for home improvement
- [Windows and Doors Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/interior-design/windows-and-doors): Window treatments and front door design inspiration guides

## Room-Specific Design Guides

- [Bathrooms Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/rooms/bathrooms): Bathroom design ideas, color schemes, and renovation inspiration
- [Bedrooms Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/rooms/bedrooms): Bedroom design, bedding guides, and celebrity bedroom inspiration
- [Dorms Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/rooms/dorms): Dorm essentials, furniture, and organization guides for students

## Home Improvement & DIY

- [Home Improvement Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/home-improvement): Home improvement projects, DIY guides, and interior design tips
- [DIY Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/home-improvement/diy): Step-by-step DIY home improvement and renovation guides
- [Paint Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/home-improvement/paint): Paint color trends and techniques for interior design projects

## Cleaning & Home Maintenance

- [Cleaning Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning): Cleaning guides, products, and tips from Real Homes experts
- [Cleaning Products Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/cleaning-products): Reviews and buying guides for cleaning products like Scrub Daddy
- [Vacuums Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/vacuums): Vacuum reviews and comparisons for Dyson, Shark, and robot models
- [Laundry Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/laundry): Laundry guides, stain removal tips, and washing machine advice
- [Pests Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/pests): DIY pest control and home maintenance guides for household pests

## Organization & Home Fragrance

- [Organization Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/organization): Organization guides and storage solutions for home spaces
- [Home Fragrance Coverage](https://www.realhomes.com/cleaning/home-fragrance): Home fragrance reviews and guides including candles and diffusers
